# La révolution du capital / انقلاب سرمایه

> Citizen treatise: oppose concentrated capital with a collective, democratic capital force in service of the common good.

Languages: French (default), Farsi (`/fa`, RTL)

## Key URLs

- Home (FR): https://larevolutionducapital.org/
- Home (FA): https://larevolutionducapital.org/fa
- Chapters (FR): https://larevolutionducapital.org/#chapitres
- Chapters (FA): https://larevolutionducapital.org/fa#chapitres

French chapter URLs: `/chapitres/{slug-fr}`
Farsi chapter URLs: `/fa/فصل/{slug-fa}` (Persian slugs)

## Notes

- Editorial content is Markdown per locale under `src/content/`.
- Stable chapter ids are ASCII; public URL slugs are localized (Persian for FA).
- Use `hreflang` alternates to map FR ↔ FA equivalents.
